set.body:
Scope: surface-view-threejs, JS assets, tools/surface-view parity harness and examples.

Deliverable: Move the JS backend and its conformance tooling to neurosurf4s, preserving scene/readback compatibility and resource lifecycle.

Acceptance:
- JS compile/tests, node parity tooling and the existing browser render/pick conformance checks pass.
- Browser checks follow repository session ownership rules and record actual visual evidence; skipped real-asset coverage stays explicit.
- Assets, fixture generators and examples move with the backend; no ScalaFIM dependency is required.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: U5: Move the optional Three.js backend and browser parity harness
